Powers.name: Anti-matter Meteor
Powers.effect:
Creatures suffer 4 automatic wounds with S: 10 AP: -2 D: 1; Sunder(2).
Vehicles suffer 2 penetrating hits with AT(1); Seeking.

Powers.name: Cosmic Fire
Powers.effect: Roll 1D6 for each model in the target unit. For every 3+ it suffers an automatic wound with S: 5 AP: 0 D: 1; Sunder(2). Can't cause more than 10 wounds in a single activation.

Powers.name: Cosmic Insanity
Powers.effect: Select one enemy unit within range. Both the caster and the target roll 1D6 and add their Leadership values to their rolls. If the caster's roll is equal or higher, the target unit suffers one Mortal Wound plus one for each point of difference (minimum one damage).

Powers.name: Form Matter
Powers.effect:
Change the terrain feature type to any combination:
- Normal terrain / Difficult terrain / Dangerous terrain
- No Cover / Light cover / Heavy cover
Powers.duration: Until the end of the game

Powers.name: Time's Arrow (only for Yngir C'tans)
Powers.effect: The target suffers one automatic wound with S: D AP: -4 D: 3; AT(4), Sunder(2).

Powers.name: Transdimensional Manipulation
Powers.effect:
The caster may heal a friendly <Canoptek> or <Necron> unit for 2 wounds. Dead models may be revived with this ability. Injured models have to be fully healed first.
If the target unit is completely slain but hasn't been removed from the game yet because of Reanimation Protocols, you may heal only 1 wound.
